title: Pending Action Kind
description: What has to happen before a pending account request, account, or relationship can move on (experimental, account.requests). Receivers MUST accept unknown values and fall back to pending_action.message and pending_action.url.

enumDescriptions.review: The seller is reviewing: matching against existing records, credit, legal, or policy checks. Normally waiting_on: seller.
enumDescriptions.sign_up: The advertiser or operator has no relationship with the seller yet. A human registers at pending_action.url.
enumDescriptions.accept_terms: A human accepts the seller's terms or insertion-order terms at pending_action.url.
enumDescriptions.credit_application: A human completes a credit application at pending_action.url.
enumDescriptions.add_payment: A human adds or confirms a payment method at pending_action.url.
enumDescriptions.grant: The operator or brand authorizes the calling agent to act for it: a published grant, or an access grant on the seller's platform.
enumDescriptions.connect_credentials: A human connects or re-authorizes platform credentials, for example through OAuth at pending_action.url.
